device.modelDescription: handlers that hang, block or end their worker, so work in flight when a worker ends can be seen failing

actionList.name: hang
actionList.description: Never answers, so the call is in flight when the worker ends.

actionList.name: busy
actionList.description: Blocks its worker for 600 ms, then answers: a message sent meanwhile waits behind it.

actionList.name: die
actionList.description: Blocks for 600 ms, then ends its worker without answering.

actionList.name: crash
actionList.description: Ends its worker 100 ms later without answering.

actionList.name: failCatalogue
actionList.description: Fails with a code from the runtime's own error catalogue.

actionList.name: failMadeUp
actionList.description: Fails with a code the runtime does not define.

actionList.name: late
actionList.description: The first call for a job answers after input.ms (default 6000); a later call for the same job answers at once, or reports progress 1..input.steps first.
